name: Canal Zero
source: According to rumors that prowl the city, every Friday, a new channel appears on television. This channel is known as ''The Zero Channel''. Mysteriously, murders and disappearances are also occurring. People are disappearing and coming back years later, intact, as if the crime had been recent.
translation: 据城市中流传的传闻，每周五电视上都会出现一个新频道。这个频道被称为“零频道”。与此同时，神秘的谋杀与失踪事件也在发生。有人失踪多年后又完好无损地回来，仿佛犯罪刚刚发生。
